0.1.name: code_context_retrieval
0.1.description: Code-to-code retrieval domain prior: match a code snippet/context to the most relevant related source code.

0.5.name: code_artifact_type
0.5.description: Type of code unit being matched, such as a function, method, class, or code block.

2.0.name: control_data_flow
2.0.description: Core control- and data-flow structure shared between the query code and the relevant candidate code.

4.0.name: signature_attribute
4.0.description: Discriminative signature attributes: argument list, types, and return shape characterizing the code unit.

6.0.name: module_context
6.0.description: Surrounding module/class context and imports needed to interpret the code's role.

10.0.name: query_code_context
10.0.description: The query code snippet/context whose most relevant related code must be retrieved; the main content axis.

12.0.name: candidate_code
12.0.description: Candidate related code unit being matched against the query code; the retrieval evidence.

18.0.name: input_parameters
18.0.description: Input parameters/arguments consumed by the code unit.

19.0.name: return_value
19.0.description: Return value or output produced by the code unit.

24.0.name: api_call
24.0.description: Named API calls, library functions, or operations invoked in the code body.

30.0.name: function_and_identifier_names
30.0.description: Function name plus variable/identifier names; the discriminative signal that separates structurally-similar code.

40.0.name: code_body_tokens
40.0.description: High-detail implementation tokens of the code body: operators, literals, and statement-level specifics.

50.0.name: behavioral_equivalence_rationale
50.0.description: Reasoning that maps the query code's behavior to the relevant candidate code (shared purpose, equivalent logic).

70.0.name: language_label
70.0.description: Programming language or task category of the code artifact, such as Python, Java, Go, or PHP.
